title: HostSendOutboxEntry v1
description: One durable send-outbox entry of the host. The rpcId is a lowercase UUIDv4 generated at enqueue and is the idempotency key of the user message; the entry is deleted only after an authoritative user_message with that source.rpcId has been observed. The state machine and crash rules are fixed by spec/host/v1/README.md section 10 and docs/protocol-changes/PC-20261112-w1-browse-outbox.md.
